_comment: THE defaults for qcar/train.py, qcar/eval.py and qcar/visualize.py -- the scripts hardcode none of these. Edit this file and run with NO flags; a CLI flag overrides the matching key for that one run only, and no script writes this file. Relative paths resolve against the HEAL repo root. Module selection (plugins, model_packages, loss_packages) follows CLI > experiment yaml (_qcar_plugins / _qcar_model_packages / _qcar_loss_packages, or a run's resolved_hypes.json) > this file. plugins: dotted module names or .py file paths, imported before the dataset is built (a plugin applies itself on import). overrides: dotted hypes keys applied after the yaml, e.g. {"model.args.fusion_method": "max"}; --set KEY=VALUE applies on top. train_epoches: null = use train_params.epoches from the yaml. visualize_out may use {model_dir} and {split}. Keys are prefixed by the script that owns them; unprefixed keys are shared: compare_ego_only_comm_range: comm_range used for compare.py's ego-only pass (small enough to drop every peer; positions are in x10 model space). compare_iou: list of IoU thresholds, first is the headline. rounds_method: zoo method whose architecture and fusion weights run; rounds_stage_sources: per-stage zoo method to load encoder / bev_backbone / head weights from instead (null = rounds_method; loads only if tensors match, warns). rounds_scenarios: null = every scenario of rounds_split, or a list of scenario folder names. rounds_cache_dir: where each method's precomputed peer features (what the peer transmits) are stored, rebuilt automatically when stale. rounds_amp: false = fp32. rounds_cache_keep_other_methods: false = building one method's peer cache deletes the other methods' caches for that split (0.5-2 GB each).
